description: Ministry of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment & Sports - amendment for the National Association of Sports Regulations, No. 01 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973. It involves amendments to existing regulations regarding financial reporting requirements for National Sports Associations. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations under statutory authority.
